lines.original: Lovin' you is easy cause you're beautiful
lines.translation: 爱你很容易 因为你是美丽的

lines.original: Makin' love with you is all I wanna do

lines.original: Lovin' you is more than just a dream come true

lines.original: And everything that I do is out of lovin' you

lines.original: La la la la la la la... do do do do do

lines.original: Stay with me while we grow old

lines.original: And we will live each day in springtime

lines.original: Cause lovin' you has made my life so beautiful
